title: Ait Bouguemez valley catchment
note: Place configuration read by the long-record pipeline scripts. Everything that is specific to one place lives here; the scripts hold none of it. A value changed here after a result was read is a new configuration revision labelled post hoc in the recipe result.

revisions.change: First configuration: geometry, strata, DEM, rainfall window, restrend_long_record and snow_cover_by_band.

Added landCover, pixel_trend_long_record and season_trend_long_record, written before any per-pixel slope, land-cover summary or June to September greenness value was computed. No value of revision 1 changed.

Added drainage_network (the conditioned flow direction and fill depth rasters of the catchment freeze, pinned by checksum), written before this pipeline built any drainage segment. No value of revision 1 or 2 changed.
Added terrain_transects (the two lines, the Tabant coordinates and the published valley floor range), written before this pipeline sampled any line. No value of revision 1, 2 or 3 changed.

Added pixel_anatomy (the pixel, its selection record, the month and orbit of the scene, and the pinned display inputs), written before this pipeline built any pixel anatomy. No value of revision 1 to 4 changed.

Added optical_visibility_by_band (the elevation bands of the strata, the winter months, the period and the two validity definitions), written before this pipeline computed any per-band clear share; the lead's published winter figures for the upper band are named as the figures to reproduce. No value of revision 1 to 5 changed.

Added proposed_routes (the origin, the pixel target, the target rule's band set and thresholds, and the bundles whose assets it reads), written before this pipeline computed any route. No value of revision 1 to 6 changed.

Restated in the configuration what the strata, land cover and rainfall builders had written into their code for this valley, so that a second place can supply its own: the WorldCover read window, the DEM ETag, the strata limitations, the area noun used in titles, and the rainfall independent recompute source, resolution note and gauge note. No value of revision 1 to 7 changed; the committed bundles rebuild from it identical except the two fields that name the configuration revision and its checksum.

Added pixel_seasons (registry 1.12.0): the March to June mean NDVI of every catchment pixel in every season, from the composites and the filter of pixel_trend_long_record, written before any per-season value was stored. No value of revision 1 to 8 changed.

limitations: The DEM is a surface model: trees and buildings raise it; radar artefacts are possible in narrow gorges.
WorldCover 2021 is a 2021 context mask: it maps only 1.1% of the catchment as cropland, and much of the green valley floor is mapped as tree cover, which may include orchards.
Strata organize field sampling; they are not vegetation types, pasture units or management boundaries.

restrend_long_record.windowRationale: Fixed by the science lane on 2026-10-28 before any MODIS NDVI value was summarized. March to June spans spring green-up from the valley floor (about 1500 to 2300 m) to the upper slopes, where the 2001 to 2013 MODIS record of Atlas catchments shows snow persisting into spring (SCI-26); March to May and April to July are the earlier and later sensitivity windows for the low and high bands. September to May is the hydrological year up to the end of the main window; November to April is the wet season of the registered season_summary recipe. The lane had not read the Sentinel-2 monthly series values of this valley; that series (2019 to 2025) was built and inspected by another lane of the project.

pixel_trend_long_record.windowRationale: The three spring windows are those of restrend_long_record. June to September was added on 2026-10-28 before any June to September greenness value was computed, at the founder's request, for the summer grazing season of the high pastures as the founder describes it (June to September); no source in the register verifies that calendar for this valley. In the snow_cover_by_band result the 2001 to 2025 mean snow-covered share of each month from June to September is at most 0.02 in every 500 m band (NDSI 0.2), so this window is nearly snow-free on average; single months can hold more. Composites from 12 July 2025 (A2025193) to the end of 2025 are absent from Planetary Computer, so the 2025 summer season holds 2 of 8 periods and falls below the composite share.

season_trend_long_record.contrastRationale: March to May and June to September share no month, so the contrast compares two separate parts of the year; March to June overlaps June to September in June.

pixel_seasons.rationale: Registered 2026-10-30 at the lead's request for a time-lapse of the valley through the seasons: the March to June mean NDVI of every catchment pixel in every season from 2000 to 2025, stored from the same composites, reliability filter and rounding as pixel_trend_long_record, so the slope it stores can be recomputed from them.

conditioning.note: Made by a private step (pysheds 0.5 is GPL-3.0-or-later, so the step stays out of the public pipeline, as the catchment freeze script does): the elevation tile named above, window 6.70 to 6.001 W and 31.40 to 31.85 N on its native 1 arc-second grid, fill_pits, fill_depressions, resolve_flats, D8 flow direction with codes 64, 128, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 for north, north-east, east, south-east, south, south-west, west and north-west, cropped to the catchment's bounding box plus 8 cells. The step reproduced the freeze: the cells that drain to the snapped outlet equal the frozen polygon's cells, 513,974 of 513,974, 0 differ. The public builder reads the two rasters from the bundle's assets; its first build reads them from data/interim/drainage/ and the checksums must match.

drainage_network.rationale: The 1.0 km2 threshold, the smoothing, simplification and vertex spacing, the 30 m height surface of the terrain strata and the 4.0 m rise tolerance are fixed in science/recipes/registry.json (drainage_network 1.0.0) before the first build; this block holds only what belongs to the place.

pixels.chosenBy: The 28 October specimen build, by a disclosed judgment: rank 3 of the candidates of the rule below. Ranks 1 and 2 lie in the lower gorge along a meandering riparian strip; this is the first candidate on the edge of the main valley floor, where the floor of tree cover and cropland meets the open slope in one straight boundary.

pixel_anatomy.rationale: The window margin, the SCL classes, the reflectance divisor, the shift of the example control and the series parameters are fixed in science/recipes/registry.json (pixel_anatomy 1.0.0) before the first build; this block holds the pixel, how it was chosen, the month and orbit of the scene and the pinned display inputs.

optical_visibility_by_band.rationale: The bands are the equal-area terciles of the strata bundle, so each holds a third of the catchment's 10 m cells. Winter is December to March because that is when snow covers the upper band and optical images of it are least often clear. The two validity definitions are stored side by side and neither is chosen after the numbers are read: any_date is the monthly median the NDVI bundle uses, three_dates is the stricter reading of the same monthly files.

proposed_routes.rationale: The field plan of the case has no coordinates (its field checks are not places), so the sites come from this rule, written by the science lane before any route was computed: the pixel the case already opens, and for each elevation band the grazing-land MODIS cell nearest to Tabant that the cost function can reach. A site is a place to ask about access, not a sampling design.
